Stock market news | RBI clarifies FEMA export declaration rules

The Reserve Bank of India issued a clarification on the new FEMA rules, stating which exporters must file an export declaration form with their bank.

The FAQs also outline exemptions and threshold limits, helping businesses comply with foreign exchange regulations.
